about.title: Lynwood Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Three people died in traffic collisions in Lynwood during 2025, out of 304 injury crashes recorded citywide. Behind each of those numbers is a household in Los Angeles County trying to keep going without someone. If that is your family, you may be able to bring a wrongful death claim, a civil case that stands apart from anything a prosecutor does or does not pursue. California limits who can file: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, but it shrinks when a city, county, or state agency is involved, which matters on roads like Imperial Highway, Atlantic Avenue, Long Beach Boulevard, and the I-105. A claim can seek funeral and burial costs, the income and support your loved one would have provided, and the harder-to-measure loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service connecting Lynwood families with an independent attorney who works on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: What a Lynwood Family Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Only certain relatives can file
items.desc: California gives the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a claim, then certain dependents and heirs. Sorting out who has standing early keeps the case from stalling later.

items.title: The two-year clock can be much shorter
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death. If a public agency, such as the county or Caltrans, may share fault, a government claim is due far sooner, so waiting is a real risk.

items.title: Losses go beyond the funeral bill
items.desc: A claim can account for burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have earned, and the loss of their companionship, care, and guidance. An attorney can help put words and figures to each of these.

items.question: My family member was killed on the I-105 in Lynwood. Does the freeway change anything?
items.answer: It might. The Glenn Anderson Freeway is a state route, so if road design, signage, or maintenance played any part, a state agency could be a potential defendant. Claims against government bodies have a much shorter filing window than the usual two years, which is one reason to speak with an attorney quickly rather than waiting for the police report to close.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves on its own track, regardless of whether charges are filed, dropped, or end in an acquittal. The criminal case may produce useful evidence, but your two-year deadline does not pause while it plays out.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge Lynwood families anything?
items.answer: Nothing. We are a free connection service, not a law firm, and the independent attorneys we connect you with work on contingency. That means no attorney fee unless there is a recovery, and no obligation to hire anyone after your first conversation.
